item.title: AM Tower Decommissioned for Safety Reasons
item.description: KCHU makes a difficult decision to take down its AM tower before it's claimed by riverbank erosion.

item.title: 2025 KCHU Annual Meeting Changed to Nov. 10
item.description: KCHU is looking for new members to its Board of Directors. Send us your letter of intent by Oct. 30.

item.title: FM 91.3 Broadcasting in Valdez
item.description: Thanks to generous donations from the community, our FM signal is now back on the air in Valdez.

item.title: KCHU Is Hiring a General Manager
item.description: KCHU, the voice of Prince William Sound and the Copper River Valley since 1980, is seeking an innovative and visionary General Manager to lead our station into the future.

item.title: KCHU Holds Annual Meeting and Elects New Board Officers
item.description: Terminal Radio, Inc. (KCHU) held its Annual Membership Meeting and Board of Directors Meeting on November 10, 2025.
